title: Account
description: Your profile, sign-in security and display preferences.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name and the email you sign in with.
profile.name: Full name
profile.unverified: Your email address isn't verified yet.
profile.linkSent: A new verification link has been sent.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a one-time code from an authenticator app to every sign-in.
twoFactor.enabledText: On. You'll enter a 6-digit code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
twoFactor.disabledText: Off. Turn it on to protect your account with a code from your phone.
twoFactor.requiredByRole: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Turn it on to continue using Mawred.

setup.enableDescription: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key.
setup.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
setup.enabledDescription: Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Use these if you lose your phone. Each code works once. Store them in a password manager.
recovery.warning: Each code can be used once. Generating new codes replaces the old ones.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password.
passkeys.name: Passkey name
passkeys.removeDescription: You won't be able to sign in with “{name}” any more.
passkeys.nameHint: A name helps you recognise this passkey later.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Browsers and devices signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise.

preferences.title: Display preferences
preferences.description: How Mawred looks and formats dates and numbers for you.

hijri.label: Show Hijri dates
hijri.description: Adds the Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date under Gregorian dates.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.description: Times are shown in this zone. Leave empty to follow your branch.
